name: Hallways Full of Mostly Illusory Opossums
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-16: Dacilane Academy's First Great Prank War
description: Several distressed opossums dressed in school uniforms and under the effects of Mirror Image fly about the hallway, guided by four giggling sprites.
disable: DC 20 Diplomacy check, DC 20 Deception check, or DC 20 Intimidation check four times to convince one sprite to undo their spells; DC 22 Athletics check, DC 22 Diplomacy check (with wild empathy) or DC 22 Nature check to subdue or soothe the opossums; or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to undo one sprites' worth of spells. Four successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine: (4 actions) The hazard loses 1 action each turn for each Disable success. Each sprite takes one action to Strike a different randomly chosen PC.

offensiveAbilities.name: New Targets
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks into the room

Effect The sprites scream "Surprise!," attempt a opossum flyby Strike, and roll initiative.
